name: stronghold-protocol-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Workers deployment of Stronghold-Protocol (additive adapter; nothing in the game code is modified)

scripts.kv:create: wrangler kv namespace create ANNOUNCE --binding ANNOUNCE --update-config
scripts.announce:push: wrangler kv key put --binding=ANNOUNCE --remote announcements --path config/announcements.json
scripts.info:push: wrangler kv key put --binding=ANNOUNCE --remote server-info --path config/server-info.json
